scope: Offline installed bare Part027 targets, fixed 35/20/28/38/55 mm linkage. Euler body rotation included. Assumed centered 566 g COM at original z65 mm. Includes translational acceleration but not link inertia, servo response, measured contact or yaw inertial moments. Four-foot force split is an unconstrained least-squares estimate; negative force fractions are evidence against the assumed support state. Run paired/flight dynamic forces are not evaluated. Negative support margins remain for Crab turns: not physical stability qualification.

motions/run/config.json.dynamics_scope: Kinematic front/rear paired bound with original 42 percent stance and flight timing. Upright centered trajectory; scheduled contacts and body pose are not measured ground forces or tracking.
motions/run/config.json.search_bounds_basis: Installed geometry, saved horn references and existing 400–2900 us calibration review window. Preserve original shaft locations and mounting calibration.
motions/run/config.json.calibrated_revision: Installed 35/20/28/38/55 mm linkage and bare Part027. 37 to 44 mm centered stroke, body Z +5 mm, 5 to 12 mm lift; existing front/rear paired timing and flight retained. Native verification is not physical loaded bounding qualification.

crawl.support_basis: Body-frame x = k0 + k1*sin(4*pi*phase) + k2*cos(4*pi*phase); y = k3*sin(2*pi*phase) + k4*cos(2*pi*phase). Offline fit with bare Part027, centered COM; no runtime limiter.

walk.stroke_basis: Installed 35 mm carrier / 20 mm crank / 28 mm pickup / 38 mm rod / 55 mm bare Part027 leg and original shafts. 37 mm planted sweep, body Z +7 mm, 78 percent contact, phase-aligned support translation and 6-10 mm broader foot lift. Numerical source validation; loaded physical walking unqualified.

leverage_validation.scope: Offline gait regression margins, not measured torque limits or servo pulse caps.

motions/locomotion/crab.json.reference: Bare Part027 wide wave gait; 40 mm fore/aft and 32 mm sideways stance stroke, 80 percent stance. Source-leg order RL/RR/FL/FR.
motions/locomotion/crab.json.support_basis: Body-frame x = k0 + k1*sin(4*pi*phase) + k2*cos(4*pi*phase); y = k3*sin(2*pi*phase) + k4*cos(2*pi*phase). Offline fit with bare Part027, centered COM; no runtime limiter.
